title: In all seven previous meetings between Swiatek and Svitolina, the winner of the first set has gone on to win the match...
author: Matt Trollope

title:
And the pattern holds for an eighth match, with Swiatek prevailing 6-3 1-6 6-3. 

Into her first final of the year (!) and will meet either Gauff or Rybakina in a marquee Toronto decider.
author: Matt Trollope

title: If (if, if) they all keep winning, we could next get a Toronto QF between Rybakina and Osaka — a first-time meeting — followed by Rybakina v Gauff in the SF, just their second-ever meeting and first since 2022.
